title: A suitable measure within familiar comfort

captions.energy: Clinging to a compulsory comfort level

meaning: Your domestic agreement offers balance when familiar convenience can fit both people’s current capacity instead of being maintained at any cost.
text: You can arrange support through fairness: recognising work, agreeing essentials and sharing manageable participation. Justice in the physical position of Muladhara describes these actions. The Devil in energy tests your footing through attachment to a compulsory level of comfort. Temperance in emotions seeks a suitable measure in which care and rest coexist. That measure cannot be found solely by reallocating duties when the number of necessary conditions remains untouchable and simplification means losing achievement, although maintaining the former amount has grown demanding for both.

For example, customary weekend preparation includes many pleasant details. You divide them more precisely while hardly any free time remains. **Balance can require a smaller load rather than another way of carrying the former one.** Relinquishing some conditions does not make home less yours. Recognised work creates a usable life where you can care and enjoy the result without continually servicing an earlier standard of appearance.

The difficulty is considering reduction unfair to invested effort. You organise better without making the task manageable. Care becomes endless work. An agreement helps more dependably when the content of duties can also be reconsidered. The chosen measure may change with your life without dismissing what was once genuinely pleasant and supportive for two people. Its value can survive beyond the size it previously had.
